data.body:
Phase 2 fix landed on branch (pre-push). Summary + before/after evidence.

Change (2 src files + 1 test):
- src/rebar/_snapshot/repo_snapshot.py: new _scoped_fetch_target(ref, remote) and resolve_ref now SCOPES its opening fetch to the requested ref. A remote-qualified ref (origin/main) -> forced tracking refspec '+<name>:refs/remotes/<remote>/<name>' (transfers only that branch, updates the tracking ref so rev_parse resolves); any other ref (bare SHA / plain name) -> targeted want. The SHA-want fallback is retained.
- Fail-closed preserved: a transport/auth/stall/timeout fetch failure is remembered and re-raised (so credential/stall errors still surface with their remedy); only a genuine 'remote lacks this ref' (git_fetch.is_missing_ref) degrades to the descriptive SnapshotRefError, matching pre-fix behavior (materialize_tickets' origin/<ref> -> local fallback still works).
- src/rebar/_snapshot/git_fetch.py: SnapshotFetchError now carries .stderr; added is_missing_ref() predicate.
- tests/unit/test_snapshot_targeted_fetch.py: RED->GREEN regression pinning the scoped fetch argv, tracking-ref update, fail-closed on a missing ref, and SHA scoping — in a blob:none clone with a large unrelated 'tickets' branch.

Fetch-boundary evidence (blob:none clone, origin.fetch=+refs/heads/*:refs/remotes/origin/*, tiny main + large unrelated tickets branch, tracking refs deleted to force a real fetch):
  BEFORE: resolve_ref('origin/main') -> git ... fetch --quiet --no-filter origin   (NO refspec) => applied all-heads refspec, CREATED refs/remotes/origin/tickets and transferred the unrelated tickets history (the 512s / 300s-timeout / ~153.6MB partial pack seen in the field).
  AFTER:  resolve_ref('origin/main') -> git ... fetch --quiet --no-filter origin --end-of-options +main:refs/remotes/origin/main   (scoped) => refs/remotes/origin/tickets ABSENT; the tickets-only blobs remain missing (regression test asserts >= 60 unique tickets blobs unfetched). origin/main still resolves via its tracking ref.

Gates (worktree venv): make lint PASS; make typecheck PASS (mypy 645 files); targeted suites PASS (test_snapshot_targeted_fetch + test_repo_snapshot + blobless_747f + snapshot_cache + stall_abort_12e4 + network_fetch_851e = 50 passed; broader -k 'snapshot or fetch or resolve or manifest' = 1171 passed, 6 skipped). Complexity ratchet: new=0 increased=0. Next: commit with rebar-ticket trailer + DCO, push to gerrit for LLM-Review + Verified.
